shortDescription: Information module for Event Series Audit Logs Parent Records

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_host
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center hostname.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_port
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center port.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: category
options.description: Category query parameter. Audit Log notification's event category. Supported values INFO, WARN, ERROR, ALERT, TASK_PROGRESS, TASK_FAILURE, TASK_COMPLETE, COMMAND, QUERY, CONVERSATION.

options.name: context
options.description: Context query parameter. Audit Log notification's event correlationId.

options.name: description
options.description: Description query parameter. String full/partial search - (Provided input string is case insensitively matched for records).

options.name: deviceId
options.description: DeviceId query parameter. Audit Log notification's deviceId.

options.name: domain
options.description: Domain query parameter. Audit Log notification's event domain.

options.name: endTime
options.description: EndTime query parameter. End Time in milliseconds since Epoch Eg. 1597961437211 (when provided startTime is mandatory).

options.name: eventHierarchy
options.description: EventHierarchy query parameter. Audit Log notification's event eventHierarchy. Example "US.CA.San Jose" OR "US.CA" OR "CA.San Jose" - Delimiter for hierarchy separation is ".".

options.name: eventId
options.description: EventId query parameter. Audit Log notification's event ID.

options.name: headers
options.description: Additional headers.

options.name: instanceId
options.description: InstanceId query parameter. InstanceID of the Audit Log.

options.name: isSystemEvents
options.description: IsSystemEvents query parameter. Parameter to filter system generated audit-logs.

options.name: limit
options.description: Limit query parameter. Number of Audit Log records to be returned per page. Default is 25 if not specified. Maximum allowed limit is 25.

options.name: name
options.description: Name query parameter. Audit Log notification event name.

options.name: offset
options.description: Offset query parameter. Position of a particular Audit Log record in the data.

options.name: order
options.description: Order query parameter. Order of the sorted Audit Log records. Default value is desc by timestamp. Supported values asc, desc.

options.name: severity
options.description: Severity query parameter. Audit Log notification's event severity. Supported values 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

options.name: siteId
options.description: SiteId query parameter. Audit Log notification's siteId.

options.name: sortBy
options.description: SortBy query parameter. Sort the Audit Logs by certain fields. Supported values are event notification header attributes.

options.name: source
options.description: Source query parameter. Audit Log notification's event source.

options.name: startTime
options.description: StartTime query parameter. Start Time in milliseconds since Epoch Eg. 1597950637211 (when provided endTime is mandatory).

options.name: subDomain
options.description: SubDomain query parameter. Audit Log notification's event sub-domain.

options.name: userId
options.description: UserId query parameter. Audit Log notification's event userId.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
